title: How does anesthesia work? - Steven Zheng
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】麻醉如何發揮作用？ - 史蒂文鄭（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: If you've had surgery, you might remember starting to count backwards from ten,
cues.en: If you've had surgery, you might remember starting to count backwards from ten,
cues.zh: 假如你曾接受手術 你可能還記得從十開始倒數

cues.text: nine, eight, and then waking up with the surgery already over before you even got to five.
cues.en: nine, eight, and then waking up with the surgery already over before you even got to five.
cues.zh: 九 八 在你甚至數到五之前 你已經完成手術而蘇醒了 你可能覺得你睡著了 但不是這樣的

cues.text: And it might seem like you were asleep, but you weren't.
cues.en: And it might seem like you were asleep, but you weren't.
cues.zh: 在你甚至數到五之前 你已經完成手術而蘇醒了 你可能覺得你睡著了 但不是這樣的

cues.text: You were under anesthesia, which is much more complicated.
cues.en: You were under anesthesia, which is much more complicated.
cues.zh: 你被麻醉了 這比 '睡著' 複雜多了 你失去意識

cues.text: You were unconscious, but you also couldn't move, form memories,
cues.en: You were unconscious, but you also couldn't move, form memories,
cues.zh: 你失去意識 而且無法動彈 無法產生記憶 或，但願，不會感到疼痛

cues.text: or, hopefully, feel pain.
cues.en: or, hopefully, feel pain.
cues.zh: 無法產生記憶 或，但願，不會感到疼痛

cues.text: Without being able to block all those processes at once, many surgeries would be way too traumatic to perform.
cues.en: Without being able to block all those processes at once, many surgeries would be way too traumatic to perform.
cues.zh: 如果無法同時阻斷那些過程 許多手術可能會因 身心創傷太大而無法執行 來自埃及、亞洲及中東 古老的醫學文稿

cues.text: Ancient medical texts from Egypt, Asia and the Middle East all describe early anesthetics
cues.en: Ancient medical texts from Egypt, Asia and the Middle East all describe early anesthetics
cues.zh: 來自埃及、亞洲及中東 古老的醫學文稿 都有描述早期的麻醉藥

cues.text: containing things like opium poppy, mandrake fruit, and alcohol.
cues.en: containing things like opium poppy, mandrake fruit, and alcohol.
cues.zh: 含有像罌粟、 曼德拉草果實、 及酒精的成分 現今，麻醉師常結合

cues.text: Today, anesthesiologists often combine regional, inhalational and intravenous agents
cues.en: Today, anesthesiologists often combine regional, inhalational and intravenous agents
cues.zh: 現今，麻醉師常結合 區域性、吸入性及靜脈注射藥物 以獲得手術需要的正確組合

cues.text: to get the right balance for a surgery.
cues.en: to get the right balance for a surgery.
cues.zh: 區域性、吸入性及靜脈注射藥物 以獲得手術需要的正確組合

cues.text: Regional anesthesia blocks pain signals from a specific part of the body
cues.en: Regional anesthesia blocks pain signals from a specific part of the body
cues.zh: 以獲得手術需要的正確組合 區域性麻醉阻斷 身體特定部位的疼痛訊號

cues.text: from getting to the brain.
cues.en: from getting to the brain.
cues.zh: 區域性麻醉阻斷 身體特定部位的疼痛訊號 傳遞至腦部 疼痛及其他訊息 以電子脈衝執行於神經系統

cues.text: Pain and other messages travel through the nervous system as electrical impulses.
cues.en: Pain and other messages travel through the nervous system as electrical impulses.
cues.zh: 疼痛及其他訊息 以電子脈衝執行於神經系統 區域性麻醉劑是藉著 設立電流屏障而產生作用

cues.text: Regional anesthetics work by setting up an electrical barricade.
cues.en: Regional anesthetics work by setting up an electrical barricade.
cues.zh: 區域性麻醉劑是藉著 設立電流屏障而產生作用 它們與神經元細胞膜的蛋白質結合

cues.text: They bind to the proteins in neurons' cell membranes
cues.en: They bind to the proteins in neurons' cell membranes
cues.zh: 它們與神經元細胞膜的蛋白質結合

cues.text: that let charged particles in and out, and lock out positively charged particles.
cues.en: that let charged particles in and out, and lock out positively charged particles.
cues.zh: 它們與神經元細胞膜的蛋白質結合 而使得帶電粒子能流進與流出 並將帶正電粒子阻擋於細胞外 Cocaine/古柯鹼 就是 執行這種機轉的一種化合物

cues.text: One compound that does this is cocaine, whose painkilling effects were discovered by accident
cues.en: One compound that does this is cocaine, whose painkilling effects were discovered by accident
cues.zh: Cocaine/古柯鹼 就是 執行這種機轉的一種化合物 其止痛作用是一位眼科實習醫師 舌頭沾到一些，而意外發現的

cues.text: when an ophthalmology intern got some on his tongue.
cues.en: when an ophthalmology intern got some on his tongue.
cues.zh: 舌頭沾到一些，而意外發現的 至今它仍偶爾用作麻醉劑

cues.text: It's still occasionally used as an anesthetic, but many of the more common regional anesthetics
cues.en: It's still occasionally used as an anesthetic, but many of the more common regional anesthetics
cues.zh: 至今它仍偶爾用作麻醉劑 但現在有許多更常用的區域性麻醉藥

cues.text: have a similar chemical structure and work the same way.
cues.en: have a similar chemical structure and work the same way.
cues.zh: 具有相似的化學結構與作用機轉

cues.text: But for major surgeries where you need to be unconscious, you'll want something that acts on the entire nervous system,
cues.en: But for major surgeries where you need to be unconscious, you'll want something that acts on the entire nervous system,
cues.zh: 具有相似的化學結構與作用機轉 但對於病人需要 昏迷無知覺的重大手術 將需要能作用於整個神經系統

cues.text: including the brain.
cues.en: including the brain.
cues.zh: 將需要能作用於整個神經系統 包括大腦 - 的藥物

cues.text: That's what inhalational anesthetics do.
cues.en: That's what inhalational anesthetics do.
cues.zh: 吸入性麻醉劑就有這樣的作用

cues.text: In Western medicine, diethyl ether was the first common one.
cues.en: In Western medicine, diethyl ether was the first common one.
cues.zh: 在西方醫學 diethyl ether/乙醚 就是最早普遍使用的一種

cues.text: It was best known as a recreational drug until doctors started to realize that people sometimes didn't notice
cues.en: It was best known as a recreational drug until doctors started to realize that people sometimes didn't notice
cues.zh: 在西方醫學 diethyl ether/乙醚 就是最早普遍使用的一種 過去它以娛樂性藥物而聞名 直到醫師們開始瞭解 人們有時沒注意到

cues.text: injuries they received under the influence.
cues.en: injuries they received under the influence.
cues.zh: 直到醫師們開始瞭解 人們有時沒注意到 他們是在乙醚的影響下而傷害

cues.text: In the 1840s, they started sedating patients with ether
cues.en: In the 1840s, they started sedating patients with ether
cues.zh: 在 1840 年代，醫師開始用乙醚 來鎮靜拔牙及手術的病患

cues.text: during dental extractions and surgeries.
cues.en: during dental extractions and surgeries.
cues.zh: 在 1840 年代，醫師開始用乙醚 來鎮靜拔牙及手術的病患

cues.text: Nitrous oxide became popular in the decades that followed
cues.en: Nitrous oxide became popular in the decades that followed
cues.zh: 來鎮靜拔牙及手術的病患 在其後數十年，Nitrous oxide/ 一氧化二氮（笑氣）變得普遍 至今仍使用中

cues.text: and is still used today.
cues.en: and is still used today.
cues.zh: 至今仍使用中 然而乙醚的衍生物 如 sevoflurane/七氟醚 更為常用

cues.text: although ether derivatives, like sevoflurane, are more common.
cues.en: although ether derivatives, like sevoflurane, are more common.
cues.zh: 然而乙醚的衍生物 如 sevoflurane/七氟醚 更為常用 吸入性麻醉常會 額外加用靜脈注射麻醉

cues.text: Inhalational anesthesia is usually supplemented with intravenous anesthesia,
cues.en: Inhalational anesthesia is usually supplemented with intravenous anesthesia,
cues.zh: 吸入性麻醉常會 額外加用靜脈注射麻醉 後者是在 1870 年代研發出來

cues.text: which was developed in the 1870s.
cues.en: which was developed in the 1870s.
cues.zh: 後者是在 1870 年代研發出來 常用的靜脈注射麻醉劑 包括鎮靜劑，如 propofol/異丙芬

cues.text: Common intravenous agents include sedatives, like propofol, which induce unconsciousness,
cues.en: Common intravenous agents include sedatives, like propofol, which induce unconsciousness,
cues.zh: 常用的靜脈注射麻醉劑 包括鎮靜劑，如 propofol/異丙芬 可導致昏迷無意識狀態 以及鴉片類 如 fentanyl/芬太尼 可減輕疼痛

cues.text: and opioids, like fentanyl, which reduce pain.
cues.en: and opioids, like fentanyl, which reduce pain.
cues.zh: 可導致昏迷無意識狀態 以及鴉片類 如 fentanyl/芬太尼 可減輕疼痛

cues.text: These general anesthetics also seem to work by affecting electrical signals in the nervous system.
cues.en: These general anesthetics also seem to work by affecting electrical signals in the nervous system.
cues.zh: 這些全身麻醉劑也似乎是 藉著影響神經系統 的電子訊號發生作用 通常，當大腦不同部位 之間互相交流時

cues.text: Normally, the brain's electrical signals are a chaotic chorus
cues.en: Normally, the brain's electrical signals are a chaotic chorus
cues.zh: 通常，當大腦不同部位 之間互相交流時 大腦的電子訊號 就像一個失序的合唱團

cues.text: as different parts of the brain communicate with each other.
cues.en: as different parts of the brain communicate with each other.
cues.zh: 通常，當大腦不同部位 之間互相交流時 大腦的電子訊號 就像一個失序的合唱團

cues.text: That connectivity keeps you awake and aware.
cues.en: That connectivity keeps you awake and aware.
cues.zh: 這種連結方式讓你 保持清醒、有知覺 但是一旦被麻醉

cues.text: But as someone becomes anesthetized, those signals become calmer and more organized,
cues.en: But as someone becomes anesthetized, those signals become calmer and more organized,
cues.zh: 這種連結方式讓你 保持清醒、有知覺 但是一旦被麻醉 那些訊號就變得較平靜、較有秩序 意謂大腦不同部份之間

cues.text: suggesting that different parts of the brain aren't talking to each other anymore.
cues.en: suggesting that different parts of the brain aren't talking to each other anymore.
cues.zh: 意謂大腦不同部份之間 不再彼此溝通

cues.text: There's a lot we still don't know about exactly how this happens.
cues.en: There's a lot we still don't know about exactly how this happens.
cues.zh: 不再彼此溝通 這倒底是如何發生的 我們仍有許多地方不清楚

cues.text: Several common anesthetics bind to the GABA-A receptor in the brain's neurons.
cues.en: Several common anesthetics bind to the GABA-A receptor in the brain's neurons.
cues.zh: 許多常用的麻醉劑會與 大腦神經元的 GABA-A 受體結合

cues.text: They hold the gateway open, letting negatively charged particles flow into the cell.
cues.en: They hold the gateway open, letting negatively charged particles flow into the cell.
cues.zh: 許多常用的麻醉劑會與 大腦神經元的 GABA-A 受體結合 它們維持通道開放 讓帶負電的粒子流入細胞內

cues.text: Negative charge builds up and acts like a log jam, keeping the neuron from transmitting electrical signals.
cues.en: Negative charge builds up and acts like a log jam, keeping the neuron from transmitting electrical signals.
cues.zh: 負電堆積就好像原木堵塞 阻斷神經元電子訊號傳送

cues.text: The nervous system has lots of these gated channels,
cues.en: The nervous system has lots of these gated channels,
cues.zh: 阻斷神經元電子訊號傳送 神經系統有許多這種門控通道

cues.text: controlling pathways for movement, memory, and consciousness.
cues.en: controlling pathways for movement, memory, and consciousness.
cues.zh: 神經系統有許多這種門控通道 用來控制運動、 記憶、 及意識的路徑 大多數的麻醉劑可能不只一種作用

cues.text: Most anesthetics probably act on more than one, and they don't act on just the nervous system.
cues.en: Most anesthetics probably act on more than one, and they don't act on just the nervous system.
cues.zh: 大多數的麻醉劑可能不只一種作用 而且不只作用在神經系統而已 許多麻醉劑也會影響心臟、

cues.text: Many anesthetics also affect the heart, lungs, and other vital organs.
cues.en: Many anesthetics also affect the heart, lungs, and other vital organs.
cues.zh: 許多麻醉劑也會影響心臟、 肺臟、 及其他重要器官 就如早期的麻醉劑

cues.text: Just like early anesthetics, which included familiar poisons like hemlock and aconite,
cues.en: Just like early anesthetics, which included familiar poisons like hemlock and aconite,
cues.zh: 就如早期的麻醉劑 包括熟悉的毒物，如鐵杉與烏頭 以及現代的麻醉劑也有嚴重的副作用

cues.text: modern drugs can have serious side effects.
cues.en: modern drugs can have serious side effects.
cues.zh: 以及現代的麻醉劑也有嚴重的副作用 所以麻醉師必須以 最恰當的比例混合藥物

cues.text: So an anesthesiologist has to mix just the right balance of drugs
cues.en: So an anesthesiologist has to mix just the right balance of drugs
cues.zh: 所以麻醉師必須以 最恰當的比例混合藥物 以產生麻醉的所有作用

cues.text: to create all the features of anesthesia, while carefully monitoring the patient's vital signs,
cues.en: to create all the features of anesthesia, while carefully monitoring the patient's vital signs,
cues.zh: 以產生麻醉的所有作用 同時小心地監測病人的生命徵候 及視需要調整混合的藥物

cues.text: and adjusting the drug mixture as needed.
cues.en: and adjusting the drug mixture as needed.
cues.zh: 及視需要調整混合的藥物 麻醉是複雜的

cues.text: Anesthesia is complicated, but figuring out how to use it
cues.en: Anesthesia is complicated, but figuring out how to use it
cues.zh: 麻醉是複雜的 但瞭解如何使用它 讓新的及更好的外科技術得以發展

cues.text: allowed for the development of new and better surgical techniques.
cues.en: allowed for the development of new and better surgical techniques.
cues.zh: 讓新的及更好的外科技術得以發展 外科醫師能學會如何 例行且安全地執行剖腹產手術、

cues.text: Surgeons could learn how to routinely and safely perform C-sections,
cues.en: Surgeons could learn how to routinely and safely perform C-sections,
cues.zh: 外科醫師能學會如何 例行且安全地執行剖腹產手術、 打通阻塞的動脈、

cues.text: reopen blocked arteries, replace damaged livers and kidneys,
cues.en: reopen blocked arteries, replace damaged livers and kidneys,
cues.zh: 打通阻塞的動脈、 置換損傷的肝臟及腎臟

cues.text: and many other life-saving operations.
cues.en: and many other life-saving operations.
cues.zh: 以及許多其他挽救生命的手術 每一年，新的麻醉技術都在進步

cues.text: And each year, new anesthesia techniques are developed
cues.en: And each year, new anesthesia techniques are developed
cues.zh: 每一年，新的麻醉技術都在進步

cues.text: that will ensure more and more patients survive the trauma of surgery.
cues.en: that will ensure more and more patients survive the trauma of surgery.
cues.zh: 這將確保更多病人 會熬過手術的身心創傷
